title: Nscale上市估值遇压 目标从300亿美元下调至160亿至190亿美元
speaker: Bloomberg

segments.en: Bloomberg understands in video about AI startup end scale is facing opposition to the valuation target of $30 billion for its IPO.
segments.zh: 彭博获悉，AI初创公司Nscale的IPO目标估值300亿美元面临阻力。

segments.en: Some investors suggesting a range of 16 to $19 billion instead as the company faces ongoing challenges including a pooled data center deal with Microsoft here in the UK.
segments.zh: 部分市场参与者建议估值区间为160亿至190亿美元，因公司面临持续挑战，包括与微软在英国的数据中心合作交易。

segments.en: Let's get more from Bloomberg, Equity, Stratis, Raheel. We had firmnesses IPO in Australia being pooled.
segments.zh: 更多内容来自彭博的Raheel。我们曾看到澳大利亚的IPO被推迟。

segments.en: We've had the financing costs for coal we've shooting up.
segments.zh: 煤炭的融资成本急剧上升。

segments.en: And now we have question marks about the valuation of end scale.
On the end scale story, there seems to be a bit of a theme here.
segments.zh: 关于Nscale的故事，似乎有一个共同主题。

segments.en: They're all neoclouds. They're all facing challenges. What's the challenge around end scale and the pushback on its valuation?
segments.zh: 它们都是新型云服务商，都面临挑战。Nscale的挑战是什么？估值为何受阻？

segments.en: There is, yes. There's a couple of challenges. Firstly, around the broader trade in general.
segments.zh: 是的，有几个挑战。首先，围绕更广泛的交易环境。

segments.en: We know that these AI infrastructure stocks have sold off quite significantly.
segments.zh: 我们知道这些AI基础设施类权益资产已大幅下跌。

segments.en: And I think there's a lot of investor angst around financing costs and ultimately whether all of this AI infrastructure spending is going to generate sufficient returns.
segments.zh: 我认为市场参与者对融资成本以及所有AI基础设施支出能否产生足够回报存在很多担忧。

segments.en: I think end scale in particular has had a lot of issues.
segments.zh: 我认为Nscale尤其面临许多问题。

segments.en: Bloomberg reported last week that there was some issues and delays with their Norway project.
segments.zh: 彭博上周报道称，其挪威项目存在一些问题和延迟。

segments.en: And I think it really reflects this questions over whether investors are going to pay peak multiples for some of these AI infrastructure companies.
segments.zh: 我认为这确实反映了市场参与者是否愿意为一些AI基础设施公司支付峰值倍数的问题。

segments.en: When financing costs are elevated, there's a lot of idiosyncratic issues and just broader nervousness around the trade in general.
segments.zh: 当融资成本高企时，存在许多特殊问题，以及围绕交易的普遍紧张情绪。

segments.en: Is this week going to come to tech trade down? A lot of big names reporting numbers.
segments.zh: 本周科技交易会下跌吗？许多大公司即将公布业绩。

segments.en: Are they going to give us what we need? Yeah, I think obviously Meta reports midweek.
segments.zh: 他们会给我们所需的东西吗？是的，我认为Meta显然会在周中公布业绩。
